raw_chunks.content: The data type of an operand usually determines the data type of the result: if two integers are added together, the result will also be an integer. If a floating point number is subtracted from another floating point number, the result is a floating point number. In fact, if a single one of the operands in an expression is a floating point number, the result will also be a floating point number, regardless of the other operands.

raw_chunks.content: Division `/` is an exception to this rule. Its result is a floating point number, even if the operands are integers. For example `1 / 5` will result in the floating point number `0.2`.
